verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a 'Test Data … Moving to Production' section (English and Spanish) and an Apple Pay sandbox testing page. That points to a test environment separate from production, but the evidence is only section headings with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of the sandbox environment itself (separate endpoints or test credentials, separation from live data), coverage of test data across payment methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
